source: Owner direct chat after the layered-column planning clarification

Record its placement and dimensions before authoring; keep it isolated from retained architecture.

Task-owned layered column and thin test-panel derivatives, editable sources and focused source changes
Existing local services/editor, compilation, focused lab PIE and actual-rifle verification in normal time and canonical slowdown
Executor self-checks, bounded controller acceptance and task-scoped local commits without an independent reviewer
runtime_test_authority: Focused automated/editor lab PIE and actual-rifle tests are necessary implementation verification. Preserve owner settings and dirty packages; runtime evidence does not grant owner visual/play acceptance.
preservation: Preserve original lobby/shared assets, ED-00/ED-01 candidate assets, editable sources and immutable evidence, and owner edits in Config/DefaultEngine.ini and MeridianSquad.uproject. Derive new ED-02 assets instead of overwriting historic candidate assets.
retained_requirements: Local accumulation, connection transition, irregular textured damage interiors, truthful residual-core and thin-panel collision, large-fragment world/mutual collision, safe firing during motion, normal/slowdown behavior, revision notifications, reset and preservation evidence remain required.
boundaries: Only MSQ-142 is dispatched. ED-03..07, new architecture, other column population, structural collapse, final dust/audio and Utility/GOAP integration remain outside scope. No new paid services or APIs.
supersedes: ED-02 prepared-only wording and independent-review requirement for this task. The ED-01 review waiver remains historic and unchanged. This decision does not approve candidate visuals or waive review for successors.
